WITH sma_10001_cte AS (
  -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'deliveries'
  -- Metric Time Dimension 'delivered_date'
  SELECT
    TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(delivered_date, day) AS metric_time__day
    , 1 AS __delivered_loads
    , case when arrived_on_time then 1 else 0 end AS __on_time_loads
    , case when arrived_on_time or not shipper_delayed then 1 else 0 end AS __on_time_measured_loads
  FROM `PROJECT`.`tessaway_sem`.`deliveries` deliveries_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_7.on_time_rate) AS on_time_rate
  , MAX(subq_13.on_time_loads) AS on_time_loads
  , MAX(subq_13.on_time_measured_loads) AS on_time_measured_loads
  , MAX(subq_13.delivered_loads) AS delivered_loads
FROM (
  -- Compute Metrics via Expressions
  SELECT
    100 * on_time_loads / nullif(on_time_measured_loads, 0) AS on_time_rate
  FROM (
    -- Read From CTE For node_id=sma_10001
    -- Constrain Time Range to [2026-09-01T00:00:00, 2026-09-30T00:00:00]
    -- Select: ['__on_time_loads', '__on_time_measured_loads']
    -- Select: ['__on_time_loads', '__on_time_measured_loads']
    -- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics
    -- Compute Metrics via Expressions
    SELECT
      SUM(__on_time_loads) AS on_time_loads
      , SUM(__on_time_measured_loads) AS on_time_measured_loads
    FROM sma_10001_cte
    WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  ) subq_6
) subq_7
CROSS JOIN (
  -- Read From CTE For node_id=sma_10001
  -- Constrain Time Range to [2026-09-01T00:00:00, 2026-09-30T00:00:00]
  -- Select: ['__on_time_loads', '__on_time_measured_loads', '__delivered_loads']
  -- Select: ['__on_time_loads', '__on_time_measured_loads', '__delivered_loads']
  -- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics
  -- Compute Metrics via Expressions
  SELECT
    SUM(__on_time_loads) AS on_time_loads
    , SUM(__on_time_measured_loads) AS on_time_measured_loads
    , SUM(__delivered_loads) AS delivered_loads
  FROM sma_10001_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
) subq_13
LIMIT 51
